items.scope: Jaspersoft products and services only.
Genetec products and solutions only.
OPPO devices only.
All ServiceNow products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by ServiceNow that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Citrix issues only.
Kubernetes issues only.

All F5 products and services, commercial and open source, which have not yet reached End of Technical Support (EoTS). All legacy acquisition products and brands including, but not limited to, NGINX, Shape Security, Volterra, and Threat Stack. F5 does not issue CVEs for products which are no longer supported.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
Supermicro branded products, managed system, or software projects.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Solidigm branded products and technologies.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Foxit issues only.
Vulnerabilities in Snyk products and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Snyk that are not in another CNA’s scope.
TIBCO issues only.
All CrowdStrike products.
All Proofpoint products.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Open Design Alliance products only.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and Eurotherm.
All SAP products.
Adobe issues only.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerability coordination for vulnerabilities in all products reported to CERT-In in accordance with our vulnerability coordination role as a CERT. Vulnerability assignments for vulnerabilities impacting all products designed, developed, and manufactured in India.
Yandex issues only.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.

CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All Wind River branded products as found on windriver.com including vulnerabilities in natively developed or modified product incorporated components, and only product incorporated third-party components not in another CNA’s scope.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Ericsson issues only.
Eaton issues only.

Root Scope: European Union (EU) member states/EU authorities, EU CSIRTs network members, and cooperative partners under ENISA’s mandate as well as other CNAs who choose ENISA as their Root.

CNA Scope: Vulnerabilities in information technology (IT) products discovered by European Union (EU) Computer Security Incident Response Teams (CSIRTs) or reported to EU CSIRTs for coordinated disclosure, as long as they do not fall under a CNA with a more specific scope.
Microchip Technology products only.
All Temporal Technologies software.
All Armis products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Armis that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Qualys products and vulnerabilities discovered by Qualys that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
